title: BatchBench: Benchmarking AI Robustness to Batch Effects and Domain Shift in Biomedical Images - A JUMP Cell Painting Leaderboard
abstract: arXiv:2610.30104v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Despite recent advances, current AI systems remain highly susceptible to domain shifts, particularly in biomedical imaging, where images are usually acquired under substantially different experimental conditions. Although recent domain adaptation methods have made substantial progress, significant performance gaps under domain shift persist. To measure progress in this regard, we introduce BatchBench, a leaderboard that evaluates and compares the robustness of AI systems on biomedical images from unseen experimental batches and data sources. BatchBench is built on JUMP-CP, one of the largest publicly available biomedical imaging datasets. Generated using the Cell Painting assay, JUMP-CP exhibits pronounced batch effects and domain shifts, making it a challenging testbed for evaluating robustness to distributional changes.

translated_title: BatchBench：针对生物医学图像中批处理效应与领域偏移的AI鲁棒性基准测试——一个JUMP细胞绘画排行榜
translated_abstract: 尽管近年来取得了诸多进展，当前的AI系统仍然极易受到领域偏移的影响，尤其是在生物医学成像领域，因为图像通常是在差异极大的实验条件下采集的。尽管近期的领域自适应方法已取得实质性进展，但在领域偏移情况下仍存在显著的性能差距。为了衡量这一方面的进展，我们推出了BatchBench，这是一个评估和比较AI系统在来自未见过的实验批次和数据来源的生物医学图像上鲁棒性的排行榜。BatchBench基于JUMP-CP构建，这是最大的公开可用生物医学成像数据集之一。JUMP-CP使用Cell Painting实验方法生成，表现出明显的批处理效应和领域偏移，使其成为评估分布变化鲁棒性的一个具有挑战性的测试平台。
tldr: 该论文推出了BatchBench排行榜，基于大型公开生物医学成像数据集JUMP-CP，评估和比较AI系统在批处理效应和领域偏移下的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces BatchBench, a leaderboard built on the large-scale public JUMP-CP biomedical imaging dataset to evaluate and compare the robustness of AI systems to batch effects and domain shifts.
